name: Minimal RAG
description: Build inspectable document-QA workflows in Python with SQLite BM25 and search/read tools. Indexing and demo run locally; live QA needs your own model credentials and provider billing.

skills.name: Index JSONL Documents
skills.description: Build a local SQLite FTS5 index from id/title/text/source records while preserving original text and character offsets for retrieval.

skills.name: Search and Read
skills.description: Search the indexed corpus with BM25, then read original document spans by ID and character offset through model-callable tools.

skills.name: Inspect QA Traces
skills.description: Record tool calls, source excerpts, source IDs and available usage in a JSON trace for checking how an answer was produced.

skills.name: Run Offline Demo
skills.description: Execute real local search/read calls with scripted model decisions, requiring neither model requests nor API credentials.
